tool.name: TEI converter
tool.description: convert linked entities to stand-off TEI annotations

param.name: input
param.label: Paragraphs with linked entities
param.help: JSON Lines, one object per paragraph, with a list of entities (by default the field "entities"). Entities with an id in the field below become annotations.

param.name: entities_field
param.label: Field with the entities
param.help: The field of every item that lists its entities, each with "start" and "end" positions. spaCy NLP Annotators writes "entities". The results are written into the same list.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: id_field
param.label: Field with the chosen id
param.help: The reranking step writes the best candidate as "reranker_results". A list is also accepted, and its first id is used.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: base_url
param.label: Link prefix
param.help: Put in front of the id to make the link of an annotation. Leave empty to use the bare id.

validator.message: Start with http:// or https://, without spaces.

tool.help:
**TEI converter** turns texts with linked entities into one TEI file with stand-off annotations, which annotation tools such as `Recogito Studio <https://recogitostudio.org/>`_ can import.
Input -----
JSON or JSON Lines, one object per text, for example from the reranking step::
{"text": "He sailed to Delphi.", "entities": [{"start": 14, "end": 20, "label": "GPE", "reranker_results": "DEL"}]}
Every entity with an id in the chosen field becomes an annotation. Entities without an id, for example entities the knowledge base had no candidate for, are left out.
Output ------
One TEI file for the whole text. It holds the paragraphs and, in a stand-off list, one annotation for every entity. An annotation links the characters of the entity (``start`` and ``end`` in its paragraph) to the link prefix followed by the id.
